scripts.typecheck: for cfg in test/base/tsconfig.json test/library/tsconfig.json test/browser/tsconfig.json test/nextjs/tsconfig.json; do bunx tsc --noEmit -p "$cfg"; done
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun -e 'import ts from "typescript"; const read = ts.readConfigFile("./node.json", ts.sys.readFile); if (read.error) throw new Error(ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(read.error.messageText, "\n")); const parsed = ts.parseJsonConfigFileContent(read.config, ts.sys, process.cwd()); const types = parsed.options.types ?? []; if (types.length !== 1 || types[0] !== "node") throw new Error(`Expected node.json to resolve types=["node"], got ${JSON.stringify(types)}`);'
